name: samurai
intent: Side-view (+X) looping walk cycle for armored samurai; steady march with opposite arm swing, jingasa stable on head.

beats.pose_description: Contact: near foot plants ahead, far leg trails extended behind; near arm back, far arm forward; slight torso settle.
Recoil/down: weight on near leg, near knee flexes; far leg lifts and starts swinging forward; arms reverse slightly.
Passing: legs cross under torso, far thigh coming forward mid-swing; elbows soft; jingasa stays level.
Up/high: far foot reaches forward before plant; near leg pushes off with extended hip; arms at extreme opposite swing.
Opposite contact: far foot plants ahead, near leg trails behind; arm swap (near forward, far back).
Recoil/down other side: weight on far leg, far knee flexes; near leg lifts into forward swing.
Passing other side: near thigh swings forward under torso; soft elbows; even head.
Up into next contact: near foot reaches ahead; far leg extends back push-off; arms wind toward frame-0 extremes.

plan.silhouette_story: Eight-frame side walk facing +X: contact → down → pass → up, then mirrored. Armor and jingasa ride the rigid body parts; stride reads as a deliberate armored march, not a sprint or fight.

differs_from.attack: Attack is a committed strike with asymmetric arm/torso wind-up; walk is a balanced cyclic stride with no strike pose.
differs_from.run: Run uses longer stride, more knee lift and arm pump; walk is a restrained armored march with shorter steps.

plan.weapon_or_style_notes: No weapon swing — empty-hand march. Arm motion is natural opposite-to-legs pendulum for walk, not punch or sword cut.
